_readme: Prices in USD used for the cost meter. Edit the copy in %APPDATA%/Cue/pricing.json (Settings → Cost → Open pricing file); it replaces this file entirely.
llm: per 1M tokens, keyed by provider, then by the model ID the API reports. '*' matches any characters; the most specific match wins. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
OpenRouter reports each request's cost itself; those figures are used instead of this table.
Groq and Gemini are priced at $0 because their free tiers cost nothing. On a paid plan, replace '*' with your plan's prices (Gemini's paid list prices are kept under '_paid').

stt: per minute of audio streamed (each lane — interviewer and mic — is billed separately). AssemblyAI bills the time the connection is open; audio streams continuously, so it is the same. OpenRouter and Groq bill only the phrases sent (speech), so their figures here are an upper bound. Groq is $0 on its free tier.
Prices as of 2026-10; check the providers' pricing pages.
